mapper.select: select evidence_id, source_event_id, expert_user_id, evidence_type, external_task_id, source_system, source_kind, occurred_at, title, summary, raw_payload, source_digest, processing_status, received_by, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from expert_service_evidence where source_event_id = #{sourceEventId} limit 1

select evidence_id, source_event_id, expert_user_id, evidence_type, external_task_id, source_system, source_kind, occurred_at, title, summary, raw_payload, source_digest, processing_status, received_by, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from expert_service_evidence where expert_user_id = #{userId} order by occurred_at desc, evidence_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into expert_service_evidence (source_event_id, expert_user_id, evidence_type, external_task_id, source_system, source_kind, occurred_at, title, summary, raw_payload, source_digest, processing_status, received_by, create_by, create_time) values (#{sourceEventId}, #{userId}, #{evidenceType}, #{externalTaskId}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceKind}, #{occurredAt}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{rawPayload}, #{sourceDigest}, #{processingStatus}, #{receivedBy}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
